courses.title: 伊泰普水電站
courses.summary: 以十二個概念任務串起水量、水力能、旋轉機械與雙頻電網介面。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve conceptual tasks connect water balance, hydraulic energy, rotating machinery and two-frequency grid interfaces.
courses.scope: 以伊泰普為案例的公開原理課程；所有自設數字均標為教學假設。三階段十二步不是實際施工順序、完整設備製造 SOP 或水門／送電操作指示。
courses.scopeEn: A public-principles course using Itaipu as its case. All invented numbers are labeled teaching assumptions. Three stages and twelve steps are not a construction sequence, complete manufacturing SOP, or gate/energization instructions.

stages.title: 水力邊界與介面
stages.description: 先把水、能量與責任邊界分開。
stages.descriptionEn: First separate water, energy and responsibility boundaries.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 劃定雙國電站系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Define the binational plant boundary
steps.objective: 分清電站、輸電與兩國電網的責任。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate plant, transmission and national-grid responsibilities.
steps.instruction: 畫出水庫、機組、變壓器與兩國電網四類節點；用不同箭頭標示水流及電力。
steps.instructionEn: Draw reservoir, generating-unit, transformer and national-grid nodes; distinguish water and electricity arrows.
steps.observation: 同一水力來源可以對接不同電力系統。
steps.observationEn: One hydraulic resource can interface with different power systems.
steps.failure: 把國界當作物理能量終點，會遺漏輸電介面。
steps.failureEn: Treating the border as an energy endpoint omits transmission interfaces.
steps.check: 逐一標出每條跨邊界箭頭的輸入、輸出與負責者。
steps.checkEn: Identify the input, output and owner of every boundary-crossing arrow.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 系統邊界決定哪些功率、損失與責任需要計入。
knowledge.textEn: System boundaries determine which powers, losses and responsibilities must be counted.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 雙國所有權與電氣連接方式是兩個不同層次的問題。
knowledge.textEn: Binational ownership and electrical connection are different layers of the system.

quiz.question: 哪個圖最適合進行介面審查？
quiz.questionEn: Which diagram best supports interface review?
options: 同時標示物理流向與各介面責任
只畫國旗與總裝置容量
把所有輸出合併成沒有單位的箭頭
optionsEn: It shows physical flows and interface responsibilities
It shows only flags and installed capacity
It combines outputs into an arrow without units
quiz.explanation: 系統邊界決定哪些功率、損失與責任需要計入。 雙國所有權與電氣連接方式是兩個不同層次的問題。
quiz.explanationEn: System boundaries determine which powers, losses and responsibilities must be counted. Binational ownership and electrical connection are different layers of the system.

steps.title: 分辨毛水頭與有效水頭
steps.titleEn: Separate gross and effective head
steps.objective: 說明水位差與可用水力能的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the relationship between elevation difference and usable hydraulic energy.
steps.instruction: 在自畫剖面標出上游、下游水位與管路損失；用假設的 10 單位水頭減去 2 單位損失。
steps.instructionEn: Mark upstream and downstream levels and conduit losses; subtract an assumed loss of 2 from a gross head of 10 units.
steps.observation: 有效水頭為 8 個示例單位，不能再把損失扣第二次。
steps.observationEn: Effective head is 8 example units; losses must not be subtracted twice.
steps.failure: 直接把壩體高度當有效水頭，會混淆結構尺度與水力條件。
steps.failureEn: Using dam height as effective head confuses structural dimensions with hydraulic conditions.
steps.check: 指出兩個水位基準，並保留損失的計算位置。
steps.checkEn: Identify both level references and show where losses enter the calculation.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 可用水頭取決於上下游能量差及沿途損失。
knowledge.textEn: Usable head depends on the upstream–downstream energy difference and intervening losses.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 示例單位只用來練習能量帳，不是伊泰普的實際水頭。
knowledge.textEn: The example units teach energy accounting; they are not Itaipu’s actual head.

quiz.question: 例子中應採用多少有效水頭？
quiz.questionEn: What effective head should the example use?
options: 12 個示例單位
8 個示例單位
只由壩體高度決定
optionsEn: 12 example units
8 example units
A value determined solely by dam height
quiz.explanation: 可用水頭取決於上下游能量差及沿途損失。 示例單位只用來練習能量帳，不是伊泰普的實際水頭。
quiz.explanationEn: Usable head depends on the upstream–downstream energy difference and intervening losses. The example units teach energy accounting; they are not Itaipu’s actual head.

steps.title: 閉合水量收支
steps.titleEn: Close the water balance
steps.objective: 檢查入流、出流與庫存變化是否相容。
steps.objectiveEn: Check whether inflow, outflow and storage change are consistent.
steps.instruction: 建立假設一小時帳：入流 12、發電用水 8、其他出流 3，全部採同一體積單位。
steps.instructionEn: Create an assumed one-hour account: inflow 12, turbine discharge 8 and other outflow 3, all in one volume unit.
steps.observation: 庫存增加 1 單位；用水並未因發電而消失。
steps.observationEn: Storage increases by 1 unit; generation does not destroy the water.
steps.failure: 忽略其他出流會高估庫存增加，進而誤判可用水量。
steps.failureEn: Omitting other outflow overstates storage growth and available water.
steps.check: 驗證入流減總出流等於庫存變化，並註明時間窗。
steps.checkEn: Verify that inflow minus total outflow equals storage change and state the time window.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 守恆帳必須同時包含流量路徑與儲存項。
knowledge.textEn: A conservation account includes both flow paths and storage.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 瞬時流量與一段時間的總體積不能直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: An instantaneous flow rate cannot be subtracted directly from a time-integrated volume.

quiz.question: 這一小時庫存如何改變？
quiz.questionEn: How does storage change during this hour?
options: 增加 4 單位
減少 11 單位
增加 1 單位
optionsEn: It increases by 4 units
It decreases by 11 units
It increases by 1 unit
quiz.explanation: 守恆帳必須同時包含流量路徑與儲存項。 瞬時流量與一段時間的總體積不能直接相減。
quiz.explanationEn: A conservation account includes both flow paths and storage. An instantaneous flow rate cannot be subtracted directly from a time-integrated volume.

steps.title: 追蹤壓力管與機組介面
steps.titleEn: Trace penstock-to-unit interfaces
steps.objective: 識別水力、結構與維修介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify hydraulic, structural and maintenance interfaces.
steps.instruction: 在概念圖依序連接進水口、壓力管、水輪機與尾水；另畫承重與檢修邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Connect intake, penstock, turbine and tailwater on a concept diagram; add support and maintenance boundaries.
steps.observation: 水路連續不代表支承與隔離責任已經完整。
steps.observationEn: A continuous water path does not by itself define support or isolation responsibilities.
steps.failure: 只檢查管徑接得上，會漏掉位移、載荷與可維護性。
steps.failureEn: Checking only matching pipe sizes misses displacement, load and maintainability.
steps.check: 為每個介面列一項幾何資料與一項需由專業團隊確認的載荷資料。
steps.checkEn: List one geometry item and one professionally reviewed load item for each interface.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 設備介面同時傳遞物質、力與資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Equipment interfaces carry matter, forces and information.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 此圖用來辨識資料缺口，不授權開關水門或拆卸受壓部件。
knowledge.textEn: The diagram identifies missing information; it does not authorize gate operation or disassembly of pressurized components.

quiz.question: 哪項資訊不能因水路連通而省略？
quiz.questionEn: Which information cannot be omitted merely because the water path connects?
options: 支承載荷與維修隔離邊界
概念圖的裝飾色彩
各節點相同的字體
optionsEn: Support loads and maintenance isolation boundaries
Decorative diagram colours
Matching fonts at every node
quiz.explanation: 設備介面同時傳遞物質、力與資訊。 此圖用來辨識資料缺口，不授權開關水門或拆卸受壓部件。
quiz.explanationEn: Equipment interfaces carry matter, forces and information. The diagram identifies missing information; it does not authorize gate operation or disassembly of pressurized components.

stages.title: 機電能量轉換
stages.description: 把水輪機、軸、發電機及頻率需求連起來。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect turbine, shaft, generator and frequency requirements.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 連接水輪機與發電機能量帳
steps.titleEn: Connect turbine and generator energy accounts
steps.objective: 把水力功率分解為軸功率與電功率。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate hydraulic power into shaft and electrical power.
steps.instruction: 用假設水力輸入 100、軸輸出 90、電輸出 85 個功率單位畫出三段能量帳。
steps.instructionEn: Draw three energy stages with assumed hydraulic input 100, shaft output 90 and electrical output 85 power units.
steps.observation: 水輪機損失 10、發電機損失 5；總效率為 85%。
steps.observationEn: Turbine loss is 10 and generator loss is 5; overall efficiency is 85%.
steps.failure: 相加各段效率會得到沒有物理意義的總效率。
steps.failureEn: Adding stage efficiencies produces a physically meaningless overall efficiency.
steps.check: 核對輸入等於有效輸出加所有損失，並說明效率應相乘。
steps.checkEn: Check input against useful output plus losses and explain why stage efficiencies multiply.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 串聯能量轉換的總效率是各段效率的乘積。
knowledge.textEn: Overall efficiency of serial energy conversion is the product of stage efficiencies.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 例子的數值是學習用假設，不是廠商保證值。
knowledge.textEn: The numbers are teaching assumptions, not vendor guarantees.

quiz.question: 例子的水力到電力總效率是多少？
quiz.questionEn: What is the example’s hydraulic-to-electrical efficiency?
options: 只看軸輸出，為 90%
optionsEn: 90%, considering shaft output only
quiz.explanation: 串聯能量轉換的總效率是各段效率的乘積。 例子的數值是學習用假設，不是廠商保證值。
quiz.explanationEn: Overall efficiency of serial energy conversion is the product of stage efficiencies. The numbers are teaching assumptions, not vendor guarantees.

steps.title: 分組 50 Hz 與 60 Hz 電氣介面
steps.titleEn: Group 50 Hz and 60 Hz electrical interfaces
steps.objective: 理解伊泰普機組分組為何需要電網介面規劃。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why Itaipu’s unit groups need deliberate grid interfaces.
steps.instruction: 依官方資料把二十部機組卡分成十部 50 Hz 與十部 60 Hz；把各組接到相應頻率標籤。
steps.instructionEn: Use the official account to sort twenty unit cards into ten 50 Hz and ten 60 Hz units, then match frequency labels.
steps.observation: 同樣的容量單位不表示兩種頻率可直接並聯。
steps.observationEn: Identical power units do not imply that different frequencies can be directly paralleled.
steps.failure: 把容量相等誤當同步條件，會漏掉頻率與相位相容性。
steps.failureEn: Treating equal capacity as synchronization overlooks frequency and phase compatibility.
steps.check: 在任何跨頻率連線旁標記需要明確轉換介面，而非直接電線。
steps.checkEn: Mark every cross-frequency link as requiring a defined conversion interface, not a direct wire.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 交流並聯系統需要相容的頻率、相位與電壓條件。
knowledge.textEn: Parallel AC systems require compatible frequency, phase and voltage conditions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本步只辨識介面；不提供實際送電或同步操作指令。
knowledge.textEn: This task identifies interfaces only; it gives no energization or synchronization instructions.

quiz.question: 50 Hz 與 60 Hz 標籤的主要工程意義為何？
quiz.questionEn: What is the main engineering implication of the 50 Hz and 60 Hz labels?
options: 只要功率相同即可直接相連
表示兩種水的流動速度
必須審查跨系統的頻率相容與轉換
optionsEn: Equal power alone permits direct connection
They identify two water velocities
Cross-system frequency compatibility and conversion need review
quiz.explanation: 交流並聯系統需要相容的頻率、相位與電壓條件。 本步只辨識介面；不提供實際送電或同步操作指令。
quiz.explanationEn: Parallel AC systems require compatible frequency, phase and voltage conditions. This task identifies interfaces only; it gives no energization or synchronization instructions.

steps.title: 辨識扭矩與轉速的角色
steps.titleEn: Identify the roles of torque and speed
steps.objective: 區分旋轉機械的運動與傳能量。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish rotational motion from mechanical energy transfer.
steps.instruction: 比較兩個假設軸工況：相同轉速、不同扭矩；用 P=Tω 標示功率比例。
steps.instructionEn: Compare two assumed shaft cases at equal speed but different torque; use P=Tω to mark the power ratio.
steps.observation: 轉速相同時，扭矩加倍會使軸功率加倍。
steps.observationEn: At equal speed, doubling torque doubles shaft power.
steps.failure: 把轉速直接當作功率讀值，會忽略負載變化。
steps.failureEn: Using speed alone as a power reading ignores changes in load.
steps.check: 列出扭矩、角速度與功率的不同單位。
steps.checkEn: List distinct units for torque, angular speed and power.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 軸功率同時取決於扭矩與角速度。
knowledge.textEn: Shaft power depends on both torque and angular speed.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 此比例比較不需要也不代表真實機組的額定軸參數。
knowledge.textEn: The ratio comparison neither needs nor represents real rated shaft parameters.

quiz.question: 相同轉速下，哪項變化會增加軸功率？
quiz.questionEn: At the same speed, which change increases shaft power?
options: 增加傳遞扭矩
只更換轉速表標籤
把角速度的單位省略
optionsEn: Increasing transmitted torque
Relabelling the speed gauge
Omitting angular-speed units
quiz.explanation: 軸功率同時取決於扭矩與角速度。 此比例比較不需要也不代表真實機組的額定軸參數。
quiz.explanationEn: Shaft power depends on both torque and angular speed. The ratio comparison neither needs nor represents real rated shaft parameters.

steps.title: 畫出調節與回授概念
steps.titleEn: Draw regulation and feedback concepts
steps.objective: 分開量測、設定與致動的訊號路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate measurement, setpoint and actuation signal paths.
steps.instruction: 建立紙上控制方塊圖：假設目標功率、量測功率、誤差比較與水量調節；加入延遲方塊。
steps.instructionEn: Build a paper block diagram with assumed target power, measured power, error comparison, water regulation and a delay block.
steps.observation: 量測與致動延遲能讓同一設定產生不同暫態。
steps.observationEn: Measurement and actuation delays can produce different transients for the same target.
steps.failure: 看到誤差就假定設備立即到位，會錯過振盪與過度調節。
steps.failureEn: Assuming instantaneous response to error misses oscillation and overcorrection.
steps.check: 以箭頭區分能量流與回授訊號，並圈出尚未建模的延遲。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish energy and feedback arrows and circle unmodelled delays.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 回授根據量測與目標的差異修正動作，實際系統具有動態。
knowledge.textEn: Feedback adjusts action from measured error, while real systems have dynamics.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本課不給控制器增益；有效增益需要設備模型及正式驗證。
knowledge.textEn: No controller gains are supplied; valid gains require equipment models and formal verification.

quiz.question: 哪個方塊不能由「理想即時反應」取代？
quiz.questionEn: Which block should not be replaced by an assumption of instant response?
options: 圖紙名稱
量測與致動延遲
步驟頁碼
optionsEn: The diagram title
Measurement and actuation delays
The lesson page number
quiz.explanation: 回授根據量測與目標的差異修正動作，實際系統具有動態。 本課不給控制器增益；有效增益需要設備模型及正式驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Feedback adjusts action from measured error, while real systems have dynamics. No controller gains are supplied; valid gains require equipment models and formal verification.

stages.title: 證據與交接
stages.description: 用量綱、可用率與可追溯資料完成概念審查。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete a conceptual review using dimensions, availability and traceability.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 區別容量、功率與電量
steps.titleEn: Distinguish capacity, power and energy
steps.objective: 避免把 MW 與 MWh 混為一談。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid confusing MW with MWh.
steps.instruction: 對假設平均輸出 2 MW、持續 3 小時的機組計算電量，並另列裝置容量欄。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate energy for an assumed average output of 2 MW over 3 hours and keep installed capacity in a separate field.
steps.observation: 電量為 6 MWh；裝置容量不等於每小時必達的輸出。
steps.observationEn: Energy is 6 MWh; installed capacity is not an hourly output guarantee.
steps.failure: 直接把官方容量當年電量，會造成量綱錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Treating official capacity as annual energy causes a dimensional error.
steps.check: 確認每個值均有單位與時間範圍，並標示假設平均值。
steps.checkEn: Check units and time ranges and label the assumed average.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 電量是功率對時間的累積。
knowledge.textEn: Energy is power accumulated over time.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 官方年度產量應連同年份閱讀，不能當作永久固定值。
knowledge.textEn: Official annual generation belongs to its stated year, not a permanent fixed output.

quiz.question: 示例產生多少電量？
quiz.questionEn: How much energy does the example produce?
options: 6 MW
2 MWh，與時間無關
6 MWh
optionsEn: 6 MW
2 MWh, independent of time
6 MWh
quiz.explanation: 電量是功率對時間的累積。 官方年度產量應連同年份閱讀，不能當作永久固定值。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy is power accumulated over time. Official annual generation belongs to its stated year, not a permanent fixed output.

steps.title: 分開效率與可用率
steps.titleEn: Separate efficiency and availability
steps.objective: 判斷同樣高效的設備為何年度輸出仍不同。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain why equally efficient equipment can have different annual outputs.
steps.instruction: 用假設機組 A 與 B：運轉效率相同，但可用時數分別為 8 與 6；在相同平均功率下比較電量。
steps.instructionEn: Compare assumed units A and B with equal operating efficiency but 8 and 6 available hours at the same average power.
steps.observation: 停機時數改變電量，即使運轉期間效率不變。
steps.observationEn: Downtime changes energy output even when operating efficiency is unchanged.
steps.failure: 只報最佳效率會掩蓋停機與維修造成的交付差異。
steps.failureEn: Reporting only peak efficiency hides delivery differences caused by outages and maintenance.
steps.check: 把損失帳與可用時數帳分成兩張表。
steps.checkEn: Separate conversion-loss and available-hours accounts.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 效率描述運轉時的能量轉換，可用率描述可服務時間比例。
knowledge.textEn: Efficiency describes energy conversion while operating; availability describes the fraction of serviceable time.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 年度比較還要控制來水條件，不能把所有差異都歸因於維修。
knowledge.textEn: Annual comparisons also need inflow context; not every difference is caused by maintenance.

quiz.question: 哪一項可直接解釋示例兩機組的電量差異？
quiz.questionEn: What directly explains the example’s energy difference?
options: 可用時數不同
效率一定不同
電量與時間無關
optionsEn: Different available hours
Efficiency must differ
Energy is independent of time
quiz.explanation: 效率描述運轉時的能量轉換，可用率描述可服務時間比例。 年度比較還要控制來水條件，不能把所有差異都歸因於維修。
quiz.explanationEn: Efficiency describes energy conversion while operating; availability describes the fraction of serviceable time. Annual comparisons also need inflow context; not every difference is caused by maintenance.

steps.title: 建立異常證據的關聯圖
steps.titleEn: Map relationships among anomaly evidence
steps.objective: 用多個觀察量區分假設故障。
steps.objectiveEn: Use multiple observations to separate hypothetical faults.
steps.instruction: 設計兩張虛構事件卡：功率下降但水頭不變，以及水頭下降且功率下降；列出下一個需核對的量測。
steps.instructionEn: Create two fictional event cards: falling power with steady head, and falling head with falling power; list the next measurement to check.
steps.observation: 相同功率症狀可能來自不同上游條件。
steps.observationEn: The same power symptom can arise from different upstream conditions.
steps.failure: 只憑單一曲線宣判機組損壞，會把外部條件當成內部故障。
steps.failureEn: Declaring damage from one curve can mistake an external condition for an internal fault.
steps.check: 每個判斷附上證據、替代解釋與未確認項，不自行解除保護。
steps.checkEn: Attach evidence, alternatives and unknowns to each judgment without overriding protections.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 故障診斷需要一致的時間基準及多訊號交叉檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Fault diagnosis needs aligned timestamps and cross-checking of multiple signals.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 事件卡是教學假設，並非電站事故紀錄或處置命令。
knowledge.textEn: The event cards are teaching assumptions, not plant incident records or response orders.

quiz.question: 單一功率下降曲線能確定什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What can a single falling-power curve establish?
options: 水輪機必然已損壞
輸出下降，原因仍需其他證據
所有保護都應關閉
optionsEn: The turbine is certainly damaged
Output fell; its cause still needs other evidence
All protections should be disabled
quiz.explanation: 故障診斷需要一致的時間基準及多訊號交叉檢查。 事件卡是教學假設，並非電站事故紀錄或處置命令。
quiz.explanationEn: Fault diagnosis needs aligned timestamps and cross-checking of multiple signals. The event cards are teaching assumptions, not plant incident records or response orders.

steps.title: 完成機電系統概念交接
steps.titleEn: Complete a conceptual electromechanical handover
steps.objective: 把守恆、電網介面與驗證缺口合成可審查文件。
steps.objectiveEn: Combine conservation accounts, grid interfaces and evidence gaps into a reviewable package.
steps.instruction: 提交一頁系統圖、兩張水量／能量帳、頻率分組表及三項待查證問題。
steps.instructionEn: Submit a one-page system diagram, water and energy accounts, a frequency-group table and three unresolved questions.
steps.observation: 不同表格使用同一邊界與時間基準時，結論才可互相比較。
steps.observationEn: Conclusions become comparable when the tables share boundaries and time bases.
steps.failure: 刪除假設標籤會讓教學計算看似正式設計。
steps.failureEn: Removing assumption labels makes teaching calculations look like formal design.
steps.check: 為每張圖列來源與假設，並由另一位學徒重新核算一個量綱。
steps.checkEn: Label sources and assumptions and ask another learner to recheck one dimensional calculation.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 交接品質取決於可追溯的假設、介面與驗證證據。
knowledge.textEn: Handover quality depends on traceable assumptions, interfaces and verification evidence.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 完成課程表示通過概念審查，不表示有權建造或操作水電站。
knowledge.textEn: Course completion means passing a conceptual review, not authorization to construct or operate a plant.

quiz.question: 哪份交接資料最可審查？
quiz.questionEn: Which handover package is most reviewable?
options: 只列總容量且沒有邊界
把所有假設改寫為實測值
保留來源、單位、假設及未解問題
optionsEn: It lists capacity without boundaries
It relabels assumptions as measurements
It retains sources, units, assumptions and open questions
quiz.explanation: 交接品質取決於可追溯的假設、介面與驗證證據。 完成課程表示通過概念審查，不表示有權建造或操作水電站。
quiz.explanationEn: Handover quality depends on traceable assumptions, interfaces and verification evidence. Course completion means passing a conceptual review, not authorization to construct or operate a plant.

courses.title: 呂勒奧HYBRIT試驗工程
courses.summary: 以呂勒奧試驗設施理解氫還原、製氫、儲存與材料證據的系統關係。
courses.summaryEn: Use the Luleå pilots to understand hydrogen reduction, electrolysis, storage and material evidence as connected systems.
courses.scope: 以公開試驗原理與紙上物料帳進行十二個概念任務。呂勒奧為試驗設施；耶利瓦勒的工業示範規劃為另一地點與尺度。本課不含化學製備、氫氣設備建造、操作參數或完整量產 SOP。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve conceptual tasks use public pilot principles and paper material accounts. Luleå hosts pilots; the Gällivare industrial-demonstration plan is a different site and scale. No chemical preparation, hydrogen equipment construction, operating settings or complete production SOP is provided.

stages.title: 試驗邊界與投入
stages.description: 分清設施成熟度、物料與能源投入。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate facility maturity, material inputs and energy inputs.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 區分試驗與工業示範邊界
steps.titleEn: Separate pilot and industrial demonstration boundaries
steps.objective: 分清呂勒奧試驗設施與耶利瓦勒工業示範規劃。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish the Luleå pilots from the planned Gällivare industrial demonstration.
steps.instruction: 將呂勒奧還原試驗、呂勒奧儲氫試驗、耶利瓦勒示範規劃三張卡按地點與成熟度分類。
steps.instructionEn: Sort Luleå reduction, Luleå storage and planned Gällivare demonstration cards by location and maturity.
steps.observation: 一項技術可以在不同城市、不同規模分階段驗證。
steps.observationEn: One technology can undergo staged verification at different scales and locations.
steps.failure: 將試驗成功直接等同商業量產，會遺漏放大與整合的證據。
steps.failureEn: Equating pilot success with commercial production omits scale-up and integration evidence.
steps.check: 每張卡均列地點、年份與已驗證的範圍，規劃不標為完工。
steps.checkEn: Give each card a location, date and verified scope; do not label plans as completed.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 試驗設施與工業示範的設備尺度和證據範圍不同。
knowledge.textEn: Pilot and industrial-demonstration facilities differ in scale and evidential scope.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本課以呂勒奧公開試驗原理為案例，不宣稱耶利瓦勒設施已完工。
knowledge.textEn: This course uses public Luleå pilot principles without claiming completion at Gällivare.

quiz.question: 哪個分類符合官方地點區分？
quiz.questionEn: Which classification follows the official location distinction?
options: 呂勒奧是試驗案例，耶利瓦勒是另項示範規劃
三張卡均代表同一座已量產工廠
只要名稱相近就不需地點證據
optionsEn: Luleå is the pilot case; Gällivare is a separate demonstration plan
All three cards represent one operating commercial factory
Similar names remove the need for location evidence
quiz.explanation: 試驗設施與工業示範的設備尺度和證據範圍不同。 本課以呂勒奧公開試驗原理為案例，不宣稱耶利瓦勒設施已完工。
quiz.explanationEn: Pilot and industrial-demonstration facilities differ in scale and evidential scope. This course uses public Luleå pilot principles without claiming completion at Gällivare.

steps.title: 追蹤礦石中的鐵與氧
steps.titleEn: Track iron and oxygen in the ore
steps.objective: 把還原反應理解為移除氧而保留鐵的物料變化。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand reduction as oxygen removal while retaining iron.
steps.instruction: 用紙卡表示鐵、氧與氫，把反應前後的元素分別對帳；不配置化學品。
steps.instructionEn: Represent iron, oxygen and hydrogen with paper cards and balance each element before and after reaction; use no chemicals.
steps.observation: 產物的鐵與被帶走的氧都有對應來源。
steps.observationEn: Both product iron and removed oxygen have identifiable origins.
steps.failure: 只比較總質量而忽略含氧量，會把失重誤當鐵流失。
steps.failureEn: Comparing total mass without oxygen content can mistake oxygen removal for lost iron.
steps.check: 各元素卡片數量守恆，並把水標在產物側。
steps.checkEn: Conserve the count of each element and place water on the product side.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 氫還原鐵氧化物時，氧與氫形成水。
knowledge.textEn: During hydrogen reduction of iron oxide, oxygen combines with hydrogen to form water.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 紙卡表達元素守恆，不提供實際反應條件或氣體配比。
knowledge.textEn: Cards express elemental conservation, not reaction conditions or gas-mixture recipes.

quiz.question: 還原後少掉的氧應如何交代？
quiz.questionEn: How should removed oxygen be accounted for?
options: 當作質量憑空消失
追蹤到含氧產物流，例如水
假定所有失重都是鐵被消耗
optionsEn: Treat it as mass that vanished
Trace it into an oxygen-containing product such as water
Assume all mass loss is consumed iron
quiz.explanation: 氫還原鐵氧化物時，氧與氫形成水。 紙卡表達元素守恆，不提供實際反應條件或氣體配比。
quiz.explanationEn: During hydrogen reduction of iron oxide, oxygen combines with hydrogen to form water. Cards express elemental conservation, not reaction conditions or gas-mixture recipes.

steps.title: 比較球團孔隙與反應介面
steps.titleEn: Compare pellet porosity and reaction interfaces
steps.objective: 理解固體形狀與氣體接觸路徑的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate solid structure to gas-access paths.
steps.instruction: 畫兩個同外徑的概念球團剖面，一個連通孔隙較多、一個孔隙封閉；標示可接觸區。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two equal-diameter conceptual pellets, one with connected pores and one with closed pores; mark accessible regions.
steps.observation: 外徑相同的球團未必具有相同內部可接觸面。
steps.observationEn: Equal external diameters do not imply equal internal accessibility.
steps.failure: 只看外形就推定還原程度一致，會忽略傳質差異。
steps.failureEn: Inferring equal reduction from appearance ignores mass-transfer differences.
steps.check: 明確區分外部尺寸、孔隙連通性與尚未量測的內部狀態。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish external dimensions, pore connectivity and unmeasured internal condition.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 固體內部的傳質路徑影響反應物能否抵達反應介面。
knowledge.textEn: Internal transport paths influence whether reactants reach reaction interfaces.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 示意圖只能提出假說，真實球團性能需適用量測與材料資料。
knowledge.textEn: A sketch proposes a hypothesis; real pellet performance needs suitable measurements and material data.

quiz.question: 哪個推論最可靠？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference is most defensible?
options: 相同外徑保證完全相同的還原表現
孔隙圖足以取代所有材料驗證
相同外徑仍可能具有不同氣體可達性
optionsEn: Equal diameters guarantee identical reduction performance
A pore sketch replaces all material verification
Equal diameters can still have different gas accessibility
quiz.explanation: 固體內部的傳質路徑影響反應物能否抵達反應介面。 示意圖只能提出假說，真實球團性能需適用量測與材料資料。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal transport paths influence whether reactants reach reaction interfaces. A sketch proposes a hypothesis; real pellet performance needs suitable measurements and material data.

steps.title: 標示製氫的能源與水介面
steps.titleEn: Mark electricity and water interfaces for hydrogen
steps.objective: 區分電解的物料投入與能源投入。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate material inputs from energy inputs in electrolysis.
steps.instruction: 畫水與電力進入電解方塊、氫與氧離開的流程；把電力畫成能量箭頭。
steps.instructionEn: Draw water and electricity entering an electrolysis block and hydrogen and oxygen leaving; use an energy arrow for electricity.
steps.observation: 電力供應來源會影響整體能源與排放評估。
steps.observationEn: The electricity source affects the overall energy and emissions assessment.
steps.failure: 把電力寫成反應物質量，會混淆能量帳與物料帳。
steps.failureEn: Recording electricity as reactant mass confuses energy and material accounts.
steps.check: 為水、氫、氧使用物料單位，為電力使用功率或電量單位。
steps.checkEn: Use material units for water, hydrogen and oxygen, and power or energy units for electricity.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 電解需要外部能量，不能僅由水的質量推算完整能耗。
knowledge.textEn: Electrolysis requires external energy; water mass alone cannot determine total energy demand.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 課程不含自製電解設備、氣體收集或通電操作。
knowledge.textEn: The course includes no homemade electrolyzer, gas collection or energization procedure.

quiz.question: 哪組資訊應放在不同帳表？
quiz.questionEn: Which information belongs in separate accounts?
options: 水的質量與用電量
兩次以同單位量得的水質量
同一時間窗的氫氣投入與產出
optionsEn: Water mass and electricity consumption
Two water masses measured in the same units
Hydrogen input and output over one time window
quiz.explanation: 電解需要外部能量，不能僅由水的質量推算完整能耗。 課程不含自製電解設備、氣體收集或通電操作。
quiz.explanationEn: Electrolysis requires external energy; water mass alone cannot determine total energy demand. The course includes no homemade electrolyzer, gas collection or energization procedure.

stages.title: 還原與循環介面
stages.description: 追蹤氧、水、固體產品與熱收支。
stages.descriptionEn: Trace oxygen, water, solid products and heat accounts.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 比較氫還原的流程邊界
steps.titleEn: Compare the hydrogen-reduction process boundary
steps.objective: 避免把局部反應與全生命週期排放混同。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid confusing a local reaction with lifecycle emissions.
steps.instruction: 畫氫直接還原與以碳作還原劑的概念路徑；另列電力、礦石與運輸的上游欄。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch hydrogen and carbon-reductant routes and add upstream electricity, ore and transport columns.
steps.observation: 反應出口的差異不會自動消除上游影響。
steps.observationEn: Differences at the reaction outlet do not automatically eliminate upstream impacts.
steps.failure: 只看水蒸氣出口就宣稱任何電源皆零排放，會越過證據邊界。
steps.failureEn: Claiming zero emissions for any electricity source from a water outlet exceeds the evidence.
steps.check: 結論標明局部製程或生命週期邊界，不把二者混寫。
steps.checkEn: Label conclusions as process-level or lifecycle-level and keep the boundaries distinct.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 直接還原路徑的反應產物與能源供應排放需分開核算。
knowledge.textEn: Reaction products and energy-supply emissions require separate accounting.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 官方化石燃料替代目標不是本課自行計算出的完整碳盤查結果。
knowledge.textEn: Official fossil-fuel replacement goals are not a lifecycle inventory calculated by this lesson.

quiz.question: 哪個主張需要額外上游資料？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim requires additional upstream data?
options: 氫還原能形成水
全生命週期排放為零
電解需要電力
optionsEn: Hydrogen reduction can form water
Lifecycle emissions are zero
Electrolysis needs electricity
quiz.explanation: 直接還原路徑的反應產物與能源供應排放需分開核算。 官方化石燃料替代目標不是本課自行計算出的完整碳盤查結果。
quiz.explanationEn: Reaction products and energy-supply emissions require separate accounting. Official fossil-fuel replacement goals are not a lifecycle inventory calculated by this lesson.

steps.title: 追蹤回流氣與水分離
steps.titleEn: Trace gas recirculation and water separation
steps.objective: 識別循環物流及其累積項。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify recycle streams and accumulation terms.
steps.instruction: 在概念圖把反應後氣流接到水分離方塊，再畫回流與補充物流；所有數值留白待證據填入。
steps.instructionEn: Connect reactor outlet gas to a water-separation block, then draw recycle and make-up streams; leave values blank pending evidence.
steps.observation: 回流可以重用未反應物，但不等同沒有損失。
steps.observationEn: Recycle can reuse unreacted material but does not imply zero losses.
steps.failure: 把回流當新的外部投入重複相加，會高估資源使用。
steps.failureEn: Counting recycle again as external input overstates resource use.
steps.check: 分別圈出整廠邊界與回流迴路，確認每條外部物流只記一次。
steps.checkEn: Circle plant and recycle boundaries separately and count each external stream once.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 循環製程的總帳與單元帳具有不同邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Overall and unit-level accounts use different boundaries in a recycle process.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本圖只表達流程邏輯，不提供分離器設計或氫氣操作條件。
knowledge.textEn: The diagram expresses process logic, not separator design or hydrogen operating conditions.

quiz.question: 整廠資源帳中應如何處理內部回流？
quiz.questionEn: How should internal recycle appear in a plant-wide resource account?
options: 每循環一次都算全新外購量
認定有回流就不會有損失
不重複算成新的外部供應
optionsEn: Count every pass as new purchased supply
Assume recycle eliminates all losses
Do not count it again as new external supply
quiz.explanation: 循環製程的總帳與單元帳具有不同邊界。 本圖只表達流程邏輯，不提供分離器設計或氫氣操作條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Overall and unit-level accounts use different boundaries in a recycle process. The diagram expresses process logic, not separator design or hydrogen operating conditions.

steps.title: 區分海綿鐵與完成鋼品
steps.titleEn: Distinguish sponge iron from finished steel
steps.objective: 辨識直接還原產物與後續熔煉的介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the interface between direct-reduced material and downstream steelmaking.
steps.instruction: 將鐵礦球團、海綿鐵、後續熔煉與鋼品四張卡排序；在海綿鐵旁標固體與多孔。
steps.instructionEn: Order ore pellet, sponge iron, downstream melting and steel-product cards; mark sponge iron as solid and porous.
steps.observation: 取得金屬鐵不代表合金成分與最終形狀已完成。
steps.observationEn: Producing metallic iron does not finish alloy composition or final shape.
steps.failure: 把還原產物直接標為完成鋼材，會略過下游品質需求。
steps.failureEn: Labelling reduced material as finished steel skips downstream quality requirements.
steps.check: 在兩個製程間列成分、物理狀態與可追溯批次三項交接資料。
steps.checkEn: List composition, physical state and traceable batch as three handover fields.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 直接還原可在不熔化鐵的條件下形成海綿鐵。
knowledge.textEn: Direct reduction can form sponge iron without melting the iron.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本課沒有鋼廠配料或熔煉程序，僅辨識產品階段。
knowledge.textEn: This course identifies product stages without steelmaking recipes or melting procedures.

quiz.question: 海綿鐵卡應放在哪裡？
quiz.questionEn: Where does the sponge-iron card belong?
options: 直接還原之後、後續鋼品製造之前
最終塗裝包裝之後
取代整個鋼材品質驗證程序
optionsEn: After direct reduction and before downstream steel production
After final coating and packaging
In place of the entire steel-quality verification process
quiz.explanation: 直接還原可在不熔化鐵的條件下形成海綿鐵。 本課沒有鋼廠配料或熔煉程序，僅辨識產品階段。
quiz.explanationEn: Direct reduction can form sponge iron without melting the iron. This course identifies product stages without steelmaking recipes or melting procedures.

steps.title: 分離熱需求與化學轉化
steps.titleEn: Separate heat demand from chemical conversion
steps.objective: 理解反應完成度與熱收支是不同檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand reaction completion and heat balance as separate checks.
steps.instruction: 畫物料流和熱流兩層圖；把加熱、散熱與熱回收放入能量層，不填實際溫度。
steps.instructionEn: Draw material-flow and heat-flow layers; place heating, losses and recovery in the energy layer without assigning real temperatures.
steps.observation: 同一物料路線可以因熱損失而有不同外部能源需求。
steps.observationEn: The same material route can require different external energy because of heat losses.
steps.failure: 只有元素守恆就宣稱能源足夠，會漏掉熱需求。
steps.failureEn: Declaring energy sufficiency from elemental balance alone omits heat demand.
steps.check: 每一個熱流都有方向，回收熱不重複計作新供應。
steps.checkEn: Give each heat flow a direction and avoid counting recovered heat as new supply twice.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 物料守恆與能量守恆必須各自閉合。
knowledge.textEn: Material and energy conservation must each close independently.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 沒有完整設備資料時，只能列需求項與未知量。
knowledge.textEn: Without complete equipment data, the result can only list requirements and unknowns.

quiz.question: 哪份證據不能單獨證明熱收支閉合？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence alone cannot establish a closed heat balance?
options: 完整且同邊界的能量帳
元素數量守恆表
帶單位的熱輸入與損失核對
optionsEn: A complete energy account with consistent boundaries
An elemental conservation table
A unit-labelled comparison of heat input and losses
quiz.explanation: 物料守恆與能量守恆必須各自閉合。 沒有完整設備資料時，只能列需求項與未知量。
quiz.explanationEn: Material and energy conservation must each close independently. Without complete equipment data, the result can only list requirements and unknowns.

stages.title: 時間緩衝與證據交接
stages.description: 以庫存模型與批次證據審視整合。
stages.descriptionEn: Review integration through inventory models and batch evidence.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 建立儲氫庫存的概念帳
steps.titleEn: Build a conceptual hydrogen inventory account
steps.objective: 理解儲存如何緩衝產需時間差。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how storage buffers timing differences between supply and demand.
steps.instruction: 使用假設庫存 5、同時段流入 4、流出 3 個抽象單位，計算期末庫存。
steps.instructionEn: Use assumed inventory 5, inflow 4 and outflow 3 abstract units over one period to calculate ending inventory.
steps.observation: 期末為 6 單位，儲存改變供應時間而非製造額外氫。
steps.observationEn: Ending inventory is 6 units; storage changes supply timing rather than creating hydrogen.
steps.failure: 把充入量當作淨庫存增加會漏算同期取用。
steps.failureEn: Treating inflow as net inventory growth omits simultaneous withdrawal.
steps.check: 驗證期初加流入減流出等於期末，並保留假設標籤。
steps.checkEn: Check opening plus inflow minus outflow against closing inventory and retain assumption labels.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 儲存設備連接製氫供給與還原需求的時間尺度。
knowledge.textEn: Storage connects the time scales of hydrogen supply and reduction demand.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 抽象單位不是壓力、容量設計或儲氫操作建議。
knowledge.textEn: Abstract units are not pressure settings, capacity designs or storage operating advice.

quiz.question: 假設期末庫存是多少？
quiz.questionEn: What is the assumed ending inventory?
options: 9 個抽象單位
2 個抽象單位
6 個抽象單位
optionsEn: 9 abstract units
2 abstract units
6 abstract units
quiz.explanation: 儲存設備連接製氫供給與還原需求的時間尺度。 抽象單位不是壓力、容量設計或儲氫操作建議。
quiz.explanationEn: Storage connects the time scales of hydrogen supply and reduction demand. Abstract units are not pressure settings, capacity designs or storage operating advice.

steps.title: 比較兩段供需時間曲線
steps.titleEn: Compare supply and demand over two periods
steps.objective: 區分平均供需平衡與每時段可供性。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish average balance from availability in each period.
steps.instruction: 假設兩時段供應為 8、2，需求為 5、5；從零庫存開始，以紙上帳記錄可轉移的餘量。
steps.instructionEn: Assume supply of 8 and 2 and demand of 5 and 5 across two periods; track transferable surplus from zero opening inventory.
steps.observation: 第一段餘量 3 可以在理想無損概念模型中補第二段缺口 3。
steps.observationEn: A surplus of 3 can fill the later deficit of 3 in an ideal lossless concept model.
steps.failure: 只看總量 10 等於 10 就忽略時序，會錯判無儲存情況也可連續供應。
steps.failureEn: Looking only at equal totals of 10 misses timing and falsely implies continuous supply without storage.
steps.check: 比較有儲存與無儲存兩張表，寫明模型忽略容量及速率限制。
steps.checkEn: Compare accounts with and without storage and state that the model omits capacity and rate limits.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 平均平衡不能保證每個時間窗皆平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Average balance does not guarantee balance in every time window.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 實際儲存還有損失、充放速率、容量與專業安全限制。
knowledge.textEn: Real storage also has losses, transfer-rate, capacity and professionally assessed safety limits.

quiz.question: 為何總供應等於總需求仍可能短缺？
quiz.questionEn: Why can shortages occur despite equal total supply and demand?
options: 供需發生時間不同且缺少可用緩衝
守恆定律因此失效
只要總量相同就永遠不會短缺
optionsEn: Supply and demand occur at different times without available buffering
Conservation therefore fails
Equal totals always eliminate shortages
quiz.explanation: 平均平衡不能保證每個時間窗皆平衡。 實際儲存還有損失、充放速率、容量與專業安全限制。
quiz.explanationEn: Average balance does not guarantee balance in every time window. Real storage also has losses, transfer-rate, capacity and professionally assessed safety limits.

steps.title: 設計批次證據與材料交接
steps.titleEn: Design batch evidence and material handover
steps.objective: 把材料身份與品質聲明連接到證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Link material identity and quality claims to evidence.
steps.instruction: 製作虛構批次卡，列原料批號、還原產品身份、檢驗方法引用與未驗證欄。
steps.instructionEn: Create a fictional batch card with feed ID, reduced-product identity, test-method reference and unverified fields.
steps.observation: 沒有批號的數據無法可靠連回特定材料。
steps.observationEn: Data without a batch identity cannot reliably be linked to a particular material.
steps.failure: 將別批次數值複製成當批驗證，會破壞可追溯性。
steps.failureEn: Copying another batch’s values as current verification breaks traceability.
steps.check: 所有數值標為自設示例或附來源，不把空欄當通過。
steps.checkEn: Label every value as hypothetical or sourced, and do not treat blanks as passes.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 批次追溯把原料、處理歷史與產品證據連為一體。
knowledge.textEn: Batch traceability links feedstock, processing history and product evidence.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本課不設定商業鋼材驗收規格；接受條件需由適用標準與買方定義。
knowledge.textEn: The lesson sets no commercial steel acceptance specification; applicable standards and buyers define those conditions.

quiz.question: 檢驗欄空白時，最適合的狀態為何？
quiz.questionEn: What is the appropriate status for a blank test field?
options: 自動通過
尚未驗證
以其他批次最高分代替
optionsEn: Automatically passed
Not yet verified
Replace it with the highest score from another batch
quiz.explanation: 批次追溯把原料、處理歷史與產品證據連為一體。 本課不設定商業鋼材驗收規格；接受條件需由適用標準與買方定義。
quiz.explanationEn: Batch traceability links feedstock, processing history and product evidence. The lesson sets no commercial steel acceptance specification; applicable standards and buyers define those conditions.

steps.title: 審查試驗工程的放大證據
steps.titleEn: Review evidence for pilot scale-up
steps.objective: 完成區分已證實、假設與待驗證的系統交接。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a handover distinguishing demonstrated facts, assumptions and open verification.
steps.instruction: 提交地點成熟度表、物料與能量圖、儲存兩時段帳，以及三項放大後需再驗證的介面。
steps.instructionEn: Submit the location/maturity table, material and energy diagrams, two-period storage account and three interfaces needing scale-up verification.
steps.observation: 放大問題包含傳熱、傳質、連續性與供應介面的共同變化。
steps.observationEn: Scale-up involves coupled changes in heat transfer, mass transfer, continuity and supply interfaces.
steps.failure: 把小規模證據直接當成所有尺度保證，會超出資料支援範圍。
steps.failureEn: Treating small-scale evidence as a guarantee at every scale exceeds its support.
steps.check: 逐句標註已證實、教學假設或待查證，並保留來源日期。
steps.checkEn: Label each claim as demonstrated, teaching assumption or unverified, retaining source dates.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 工程成熟度依賴可轉移的證據，而非僅依賴項目名稱。
knowledge.textEn: Engineering maturity depends on transferable evidence, not the project name alone.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 完成十二步代表概念審查，不代表完成氫系統設計或商業生產認證。
knowledge.textEn: Completing twelve tasks is a conceptual review, not hydrogen-system design or commercial-production certification.

quiz.question: 哪個交接最能避免誇大試驗成果？
quiz.questionEn: Which handover best avoids overstating pilot results?
options: 只寫技術已完全成熟
刪除地點與年份以免比較
明列規模、邊界與尚需驗證的介面
optionsEn: State only that the technology is fully mature
Remove locations and dates to prevent comparison
State scale, boundaries and interfaces still requiring verification
quiz.explanation: 工程成熟度依賴可轉移的證據，而非僅依賴項目名稱。 完成十二步代表概念審查，不代表完成氫系統設計或商業生產認證。
quiz.explanationEn: Engineering maturity depends on transferable evidence, not the project name alone. Completing twelve tasks is a conceptual review, not hydrogen-system design or commercial-production certification.

courses.title: EMI早期電腦斷層掃描器工程
courses.titleEn: EMI Early Computed Tomography Scanner Engineering
courses.summary: 從 EMI 早期設備史出發，以數位假體拆解投影、重建與影像品質。
courses.summaryEn: Start with early EMI equipment history and use digital phantoms to study projections, reconstruction and image quality.
courses.scope: 十二步限於設備物理、數位假體與品質追溯。歷史設備與現代 QA 來源分別標示，不推定規格相同。不操作輻射設備、不使用病人資料、不提供診斷、治療或臨床掃描設定；不是醫療設備製造或驗收 SOP。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve tasks cover equipment physics, digital phantoms and quality traceability. Historical equipment and modern QA sources are distinguished without assuming identical specifications. No radiation equipment, patient data, diagnosis, treatment or clinical scan settings are used; this is not a medical-device manufacturing or acceptance SOP.

stages.title: 證據、假體與投影
stages.description: 用已知數位矩陣建立可追溯的反問題。
stages.descriptionEn: Build a traceable inverse problem from a known digital matrix.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 建立早期 CT 的證據與功能邊界
steps.titleEn: Establish evidence and function boundaries for early CT
steps.objective: 區分歷史設備事實、重建原理與現代品質方法。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish historical equipment facts, reconstruction principles and modern quality methods.
steps.instruction: 排列多角度衰減投影、重建、影像三張卡；將 EMI 典藏紀錄與現代品質指南分欄。
steps.instructionEn: Order multi-angle attenuation projections, reconstruction and image cards; separate the EMI collection record from modern quality guidance.
steps.observation: 歷史設備與現代品質原理可以互相說明，但不能假定規格完全相同。
steps.observationEn: Historical equipment and modern quality principles can inform each other without implying identical specifications.
steps.failure: 把現代指南中的性能值套回 1971 年設備，會造成時代錯置。
steps.failureEn: Assigning modern performance values to the 1971 instrument creates an anachronism.
steps.check: 每項主張都有歷史或原理標籤，並附相對應來源。
steps.checkEn: Label every claim as historical or conceptual and attach the appropriate source.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: CT 從多方向的衰減資訊推估物體內部的空間分布。
knowledge.textEn: CT estimates internal spatial distributions from attenuation information collected in multiple directions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本課只使用數位假體，不操作 X 光設備或解讀病人影像。
knowledge.textEn: This course uses digital phantoms only, without operating X-ray equipment or interpreting patient images.

quiz.question: 哪條資訊鏈最符合 CT 的基本原理？
quiz.questionEn: Which information chain best describes CT?
options: 多角度投影→計算重建→影像
單張外觀照片→直接得知所有內部細節
先指定診斷→再修改投影符合答案
optionsEn: Multi-angle projections → computational reconstruction → image
One external photograph → complete internal detail
Assign diagnosis → alter projections to match it
quiz.explanation: CT 從多方向的衰減資訊推估物體內部的空間分布。 本課只使用數位假體，不操作 X 光設備或解讀病人影像。
quiz.explanationEn: CT estimates internal spatial distributions from attenuation information collected in multiple directions. This course uses digital phantoms only, without operating X-ray equipment or interpreting patient images.

steps.title: 建立帶座標的數位假體
steps.titleEn: Build a coordinate-labelled digital phantom
steps.objective: 使像素位置、數值與已知真值可追溯。
steps.objectiveEn: Make pixel location, value and known ground truth traceable.
steps.instruction: 畫 2×2 假體，第一列 1、2，第二列 3、4；標列、欄與任意衰減單位。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a 2×2 phantom with rows [1,2] and [3,4]; label rows, columns and arbitrary attenuation units.
steps.observation: 四個像素的座標與數值具有確定對應。
steps.observationEn: Each of the four pixel coordinates has a defined value.
steps.failure: 轉置陣列但不改座標標示，會讓方向判讀錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Transposing the array without relabelling coordinates causes orientation errors.
steps.check: 請另一位學徒按座標重建同一矩陣，核對四個位置。
steps.checkEn: Ask another learner to reproduce the matrix from coordinates and check all four positions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 數位假體提供已知真值，便於測試演算法而不涉及人體。
knowledge.textEn: A digital phantom provides known ground truth for testing algorithms without human subjects.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 任意單位不是人體組織的 CT 值，也沒有診斷意義。
knowledge.textEn: Arbitrary units are not tissue CT values and have no diagnostic meaning.

quiz.question: 為什麼假體必須標座標？
quiz.questionEn: Why must the phantom have coordinate labels?
options: 使所有像素自動變得相同
讓位置與數值對應可以重現
讓任意數字成為病人測量值
optionsEn: To make all pixels identical automatically
To reproduce the mapping between location and value
To turn arbitrary numbers into patient measurements
quiz.explanation: 數位假體提供已知真值，便於測試演算法而不涉及人體。 任意單位不是人體組織的 CT 值，也沒有診斷意義。
quiz.explanationEn: A digital phantom provides known ground truth for testing algorithms without human subjects. Arbitrary units are not tissue CT values and have no diagnostic meaning.

steps.title: 計算兩方向的線積分近似
steps.titleEn: Calculate two-direction line-sum approximations
steps.objective: 理解投影如何壓縮沿路徑的資訊。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how projections combine information along paths.
steps.instruction: 對前步 2×2 假體算列和 3、7 與欄和 4、6，保留其方向標籤。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate row sums 3,7 and column sums 4,6 for the previous 2×2 phantom, retaining direction labels.
steps.observation: 每個和只保留沿一條路徑的總貢獻。
steps.observationEn: Each sum retains only the total contribution along one path.
steps.failure: 把某條投影和當成單一像素值，會混淆量測與未知量。
steps.failureEn: Treating a projection sum as one pixel confuses measurements with unknowns.
steps.check: 確認兩方向的總和都為 10，並註明這是簡化線和模型。
steps.checkEn: Confirm both directions total 10 and label this as a simplified line-sum model.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 理想化 CT 投影可用沿射線的衰減積分表示。
knowledge.textEn: Idealized CT projections can be represented by attenuation integrals along rays.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本例略去射束能譜、散射與探測器效應，只教幾何與守恆。
knowledge.textEn: This example omits spectra, scatter and detector effects to teach geometry and conservation.

quiz.question: 第一列的投影和是多少？
quiz.questionEn: What is the first row’s projection sum?
quiz.explanation: 理想化 CT 投影可用沿射線的衰減積分表示。 本例略去射束能譜、散射與探測器效應，只教幾何與守恆。
quiz.explanationEn: Idealized CT projections can be represented by attenuation integrals along rays. This example omits spectra, scatter and detector effects to teach geometry and conservation.

steps.title: 辨識有限角度的不唯一性
steps.titleEn: Identify ambiguity from limited directions
steps.objective: 說明少量投影不能唯一決定內部矩陣。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain why a few projections need not uniquely determine an internal matrix.
steps.instructionEn: Compare row and column sums of matrices [1,2;3,4] and [2,1;2,5].
steps.observation: 兩矩陣都有列和 3、7 與欄和 4、6，但內部數值不同。
steps.observationEn: Both have row sums 3,7 and column sums 4,6 despite different internal values.
steps.failure: 只匹配兩方向投影就宣稱真值唯一，會掩蓋資料不足。
steps.failureEn: Claiming unique truth from two matching directions hides insufficient data.
steps.check: 列出另一方向或額外限制可能補充的資訊，不憑空假設真值。
steps.checkEn: List information another direction or constraint could add without assuming the true answer.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 反問題可能有多個符合少量量測的解。
knowledge.textEn: An inverse problem can have multiple solutions consistent with limited measurements.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 資料一致性是必要檢查，但不自動等於唯一或正確重建。
knowledge.textEn: Data consistency is necessary but does not automatically imply a unique or correct reconstruction.

quiz.question: 相同兩方向投影可以證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What do equal projections in two directions establish?
options: 在這些量測下相容，但不保證內部唯一
每個內部像素必定相同
多角度量測毫無價值
optionsEn: Consistency with those measurements, without guaranteeing a unique interior
Every internal pixel must be identical
Additional angles have no value
quiz.explanation: 反問題可能有多個符合少量量測的解。 資料一致性是必要檢查，但不自動等於唯一或正確重建。
quiz.explanationEn: An inverse problem can have multiple solutions consistent with limited measurements. Data consistency is necessary but does not automatically imply a unique or correct reconstruction.

stages.title: 資料鏈與重建
stages.description: 比較正規化、角度索引、反投影與前向檢查。
stages.descriptionEn: Compare normalization, angle indexing, backprojection and forward checks.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 區分原始訊號與正規化資料
steps.titleEn: Separate raw signals from normalized data
steps.objective: 理解參考訊號與探測器偏差的角色。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand reference signals and detector bias.
steps.instruction: 製作兩個虛構探測器卡，寫相同物體訊號但不同空白參考；標示需要校正的比較。
steps.instructionEn: Make two fictional detector cards with equal object signals but different blank references; mark the comparison needing correction.
steps.observation: 原始數值相同不一定代表相同衰減比例。
steps.observationEn: Equal raw values do not necessarily represent equal attenuation ratios.
steps.failure: 忽略參考值漂移，可能把儀器差異誤認為物體差異。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring reference drift can mistake instrumental differences for object differences.
steps.check: 在資料表保留原始值、參考值、校正版本三欄。
steps.checkEn: Retain raw value, reference value and calibration version in separate columns.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 量測需相對適當參考解讀，探測器偏差會傳到重建結果。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements require suitable references, and detector bias propagates into reconstruction.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本課僅分類校正資料，不提供醫療設備現場校正操作。
knowledge.textEn: This task classifies calibration information without instructing onsite medical-equipment calibration.

quiz.question: 相同原始讀值、不同參考值時，應先做什麼？
quiz.questionEn: With equal raw readings but different references, what comes first?
options: 直接宣稱兩個衰減量完全相同
審查正規化及參考一致性
刪除參考值以方便比較
optionsEn: Declare the attenuation values identical
Review normalization and reference consistency
Delete references to simplify comparison
quiz.explanation: 量測需相對適當參考解讀，探測器偏差會傳到重建結果。 本課僅分類校正資料，不提供醫療設備現場校正操作。
quiz.explanationEn: Measurements require suitable references, and detector bias propagates into reconstruction. This task classifies calibration information without instructing onsite medical-equipment calibration.

steps.title: 組織投影角度索引
steps.titleEn: Organize projection-angle indexing
steps.objective: 保持角度、探測器位置與量測值同步。
steps.objectiveEn: Keep angle, detector position and measurement value synchronized.
steps.instruction: 以三個假設角度與兩個探測器位置製作六格資料表，給每格唯一索引。
steps.instructionEn: Make a six-cell table for three assumed angles and two detector positions, assigning a unique index to each cell.
steps.observation: 重排角度列時，對應數值必須一起移動。
steps.observationEn: Reordering angle rows requires moving the corresponding values with them.
steps.failure: 只排序角度標籤而不移動數值，會造成錯誤幾何配對。
steps.failureEn: Sorting angle labels alone creates incorrect geometry–value pairings.
steps.check: 隨機挑一格，能追溯其角度、位置與來源是假設還是引用。
steps.checkEn: Trace one selected cell to its angle, position and hypothetical or cited origin.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 投影集合的幾何索引是重建輸入的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Geometric indexing is part of the reconstruction input.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 這是自建小型資料表，不代表課程提供真實掃描器量測資料。
knowledge.textEn: This is a learner-built small table, not a supplied real-scanner dataset.

quiz.question: 排序投影時哪些資料必須一起移動？
quiz.questionEn: What must move together when projections are sorted?
options: 只有角度文字
只有表格顏色
角度、位置與其對應數值
optionsEn: Angle text alone
Table colours alone
Angle, position and associated value
quiz.explanation: 投影集合的幾何索引是重建輸入的一部分。 這是自建小型資料表，不代表課程提供真實掃描器量測資料。
quiz.explanationEn: Geometric indexing is part of the reconstruction input. This is a learner-built small table, not a supplied real-scanner dataset.

steps.title: 觀察簡單反投影的模糊
steps.titleEn: Observe blur in simple backprojection
steps.objective: 理解把投影展回路徑不會立即恢復真值。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why spreading projections back along paths does not immediately recover ground truth.
steps.instruction: 把列和與欄和以半透明色帶展回 2×2 格線；與原假體逐格比較。
steps.instructionEn: Spread row and column sums back onto a 2×2 grid as translucent bands, then compare with the original phantom.
steps.observation: 不同路徑的貢獻疊加，但細節不必等於原矩陣。
steps.observationEn: Contributions from different paths overlap without necessarily reproducing the original matrix.
steps.failure: 把較亮的疊加圖直接稱為準確重建，會忽略模糊與正規化。
steps.failureEn: Calling a brighter overlay accurate reconstruction ignores blur and normalization.
steps.check: 列出至少兩格差異，明確標為未濾波概念反投影。
steps.checkEn: List at least two cell differences and label the result conceptual unfiltered backprojection.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 反投影把投影資訊分配回空間，仍需適當重建方法控制模糊。
knowledge.textEn: Backprojection redistributes projection information into space; suitable reconstruction methods are still needed to manage blur.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 少量角度的手繪示例不能用來評價臨床影像性能。
knowledge.textEn: A few-angle sketch cannot assess clinical image performance.

quiz.question: 反投影疊加後應先檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What should be checked after backprojection overlap?
options: 與已知假體的差異及所用方法限制
影像顏色是否好看
是否可直接作診斷
optionsEn: Differences from known ground truth and method limitations
Whether the colours are attractive
Whether it can immediately support diagnosis
quiz.explanation: 反投影把投影資訊分配回空間，仍需適當重建方法控制模糊。 少量角度的手繪示例不能用來評價臨床影像性能。
quiz.explanationEn: Backprojection redistributes projection information into space; suitable reconstruction methods are still needed to manage blur. A few-angle sketch cannot assess clinical image performance.

steps.title: 用前向投影檢查候選重建
steps.titleEn: Check a candidate reconstruction by forward projection
steps.objective: 將候選影像重新投影以檢查資料一致性。
steps.objectiveEn: Reproject a candidate image to check measurement consistency.
steps.instruction: 對候選矩陣 [1,1;3,4] 算列和與欄和，與目標 3、7 與 4、6 比較。
steps.instructionEn: Compute row and column sums for candidate [1,1;3,4] and compare with targets 3,7 and 4,6.
steps.observation: 第一列與第二欄各少 1，顯示候選未符合全部資料。
steps.observationEn: The first row and second column are each short by 1, so the candidate does not fit all data.
steps.failure: 只比較總亮度可能漏掉哪條路徑不一致。
steps.failureEn: Comparing total brightness alone can miss which path is inconsistent.
steps.check: 逐路徑列殘差並保留正負號，不擅自更改目標資料。
steps.checkEn: List signed residuals for each path without changing the target data.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 前向模型把候選解轉回量測空間，便於比較殘差。
knowledge.textEn: A forward model maps a candidate solution back into measurement space for residual comparison.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 殘差為零仍受有限角度的不唯一性限制。
knowledge.textEn: Zero residual still does not resolve ambiguity from limited angles.

quiz.question: 示例候選哪裡不符合目標？
quiz.questionEn: Where does the candidate fail to match the target?
options: 每條路徑都完全符合
第一列與第二欄各少 1
只有顏色不同，數值都相同
optionsEn: Every path matches exactly
The first row and second column are each short by 1
Only colours differ; all values agree
quiz.explanation: 前向模型把候選解轉回量測空間，便於比較殘差。 殘差為零仍受有限角度的不唯一性限制。
quiz.explanationEn: A forward model maps a candidate solution back into measurement space for residual comparison. Zero residual still does not resolve ambiguity from limited angles.

stages.title: 品質特徵與驗證報告
stages.description: 分別審視偏差、雜訊、細節與可重現性。
stages.descriptionEn: Review bias, noise, detail and reproducibility separately.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 比較均勻區的偏差與雜訊
steps.titleEn: Compare bias and noise in a uniform region
steps.objective: 區分整體偏移與數值分散。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish overall offset from spread.
steps.instructionEn: With example truth 10, compare regions A=[10,10,10], B=[9,10,11] and C=[12,12,12].
steps.observation: B 有分散但平均為 10；C 一致但有偏差。
steps.observationEn: B has spread with mean 10; C is consistent but biased.
steps.failure: 把低雜訊直接當作準確，會忽略系統性偏移。
steps.failureEn: Treating low noise as accuracy ignores systematic bias.
steps.check: 分開寫平均差與數值分散，全部標任意教學單位。
steps.checkEn: Report mean error and spread separately, using arbitrary teaching units.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 準確度、均勻性與雜訊描述不同品質特徵。
knowledge.textEn: Accuracy, uniformity and noise describe different quality characteristics.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 示例不含人體 CT 值或臨床合格門檻。
knowledge.textEn: The example contains no tissue CT values or clinical acceptance thresholds.

quiz.question: 哪個區域示範一致但有偏差？
quiz.questionEn: Which region is consistent but biased?
options: 只要一致就不可能有偏差
optionsEn: Consistency makes bias impossible
quiz.explanation: 準確度、均勻性與雜訊描述不同品質特徵。 示例不含人體 CT 值或臨床合格門檻。
quiz.explanationEn: Accuracy, uniformity and noise describe different quality characteristics. The example contains no tissue CT values or clinical acceptance thresholds.

steps.title: 辨識解析度與平滑的取捨
steps.titleEn: Identify the resolution–smoothing trade-off
steps.objective: 說明降低波動可能同時抹去細節。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how reducing variation can also erase detail.
steps.instruction: 畫一條含單格窄峰的數位剖面，與三格移動平均後的剖面比較峰寬與峰高。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a digital profile with a one-cell narrow peak and compare peak width and height after a three-cell moving average.
steps.observation: 平滑可能降低局部波動，也使窄峰展寬。
steps.observationEn: Smoothing can reduce local variation while broadening a narrow peak.
steps.failure: 只以平滑外觀評分，會忽略小特徵辨識能力。
steps.failureEn: Scoring only smooth appearance ignores small-feature visibility.
steps.check: 同時記錄波動改變與峰形改變，說明選用方法的目的。
steps.checkEn: Record both variation and peak-shape changes and explain the method’s purpose.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 處理方法可以在雜訊與空間細節之間產生取捨。
knowledge.textEn: Processing methods can create a trade-off between noise and spatial detail.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 這是訊號處理練習，不建議病人掃描參數或影像診斷設定。
knowledge.textEn: This is signal-processing practice, not advice on patient scanning or diagnostic settings.

quiz.question: 平滑後圖更平順能證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What does a smoother result establish?
options: 波動改變了，仍需檢查細節損失
所有影像品質都一定提高
可忽略解析度評估
optionsEn: Variation changed; detail loss still needs checking
Every aspect of image quality improved
Resolution assessment is unnecessary
quiz.explanation: 處理方法可以在雜訊與空間細節之間產生取捨。 這是訊號處理練習，不建議病人掃描參數或影像診斷設定。
quiz.explanationEn: Processing methods can create a trade-off between noise and spatial detail. This is signal-processing practice, not advice on patient scanning or diagnostic settings.

steps.title: 把假體異常連回資料鏈
steps.titleEn: Trace phantom anomalies through the data chain
steps.objective: 用可測假說區分物體、探測器與重建問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate object, detector and reconstruction issues using testable hypotheses.
steps.instruction: 製作虛構案例：同一資料用兩個重建版本得到不同條紋；列出版本、校正與角度索引檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Create a fictional case where one dataset produces different streaks with two reconstruction versions; list version, calibration and angle-index checks.
steps.observation: 資料相同而處理結果不同，應先審查處理鏈差異。
steps.observationEn: When identical data produce different outputs, processing-chain differences deserve initial review.
steps.failure: 看到條紋就宣告病理異常，會越過設備品質課程的用途。
steps.failureEn: Declaring pathology from streaks exceeds the purpose of an equipment-quality lesson.
steps.check: 每個假說附可重現比較，不對病人作任何結論。
steps.checkEn: Attach a reproducible comparison to each hypothesis and make no patient conclusions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 品質調查需要控制變因，才能把差異連回資料鏈。
knowledge.textEn: Quality investigation needs controlled variables to link differences to the data chain.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 此處所有案例為虛構數位假體，不是臨床判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Every case here is a fictional digital phantom, not clinical interpretation.

quiz.question: 同資料但不同重建版本出現差異時，首先應保留什麼？
quiz.questionEn: With one dataset and different reconstruction outputs, what should be retained first?
options: 只保留較漂亮的圖
輸入資料與軟體版本的可追溯紀錄
任意修改資料直到兩圖相同
optionsEn: Only the more attractive image
Traceable records of input data and software versions
Arbitrarily alter data until the images agree
quiz.explanation: 品質調查需要控制變因，才能把差異連回資料鏈。 此處所有案例為虛構數位假體，不是臨床判讀。
quiz.explanationEn: Quality investigation needs controlled variables to link differences to the data chain. Every case here is a fictional digital phantom, not clinical interpretation.

steps.title: 完成無輻射的重建品質報告
steps.titleEn: Complete a radiation-free reconstruction quality report
steps.objective: 交付可重現、有限度的數位假體驗證。
steps.objectiveEn: Deliver reproducible, bounded digital-phantom verification.
steps.instruction: 整理假體矩陣、投影索引、候選殘差、偏差雜訊比較與方法版本，附來源和限制。
steps.instructionEn: Compile the phantom matrix, projection indices, candidate residuals, bias/noise comparison and method version, with sources and limitations.
steps.observation: 已知真值、輸入與方法同時保存，才容易獨立重現。
steps.observationEn: Independent reproduction requires preserved ground truth, inputs and methods together.
steps.failure: 把概念測試通過寫成醫療設備合格，會誇大驗證範圍。
steps.failureEn: Calling a passed concept test medical-device approval exaggerates verification scope.
steps.check: 讓另一位學徒重算一條投影；報告明言沒有真實掃描、診斷或治療。
steps.checkEn: Have another learner recalculate one projection; state that no real scan, diagnosis or treatment occurred.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 可重現報告應保留資料來源、方法、版本與適用邊界。
knowledge.textEn: A reproducible report preserves data origin, method, version and applicability boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 完成本課只表示掌握影像物理的概念證據，不構成臨床能力認證。
knowledge.textEn: Completion demonstrates conceptual evidence in imaging physics, not certification of clinical competence.

quiz.question: 哪份報告的結論符合證據？
quiz.questionEn: Which report conclusion matches the evidence?
options: 所有 CT 設備均已通過驗收
可直接替代醫療專業判讀
此數位假體在指定模型下通過已列檢查
optionsEn: All CT devices have passed acceptance
It can replace professional clinical interpretation
This digital phantom passed the listed checks under the stated model
quiz.explanation: 可重現報告應保留資料來源、方法、版本與適用邊界。 完成本課只表示掌握影像物理的概念證據，不構成臨床能力認證。
quiz.explanationEn: A reproducible report preserves data origin, method, version and applicability boundaries. Completion demonstrates conceptual evidence in imaging physics, not certification of clinical competence.

courses.title: 卡倫堡工業共生系統
courses.summary: 以卡倫堡為背景，從資源盤點、介面計量到合作治理建立工業共生概念方案。
courses.summaryEn: Use Kalundborg as context for a conceptual industrial-symbiosis proposal covering resource inventories, metering interfaces and cooperation.
courses.scope: 三階段十二步以原創虛構企業與明示假設帳進行概念規劃；官方案例支持原理與歷史，不代表提供現行合約或實際管網數據。不是工廠連接、處理配方、法律合約或完整操作 SOP。
courses.scopeEn: Three stages and twelve tasks use fictional firms and explicitly assumed accounts for conceptual planning. Official cases support principles and history, not current contracts or real pipeline data. This is not a plant-connection procedure, treatment recipe, legal contract or complete operating SOP.

stages.title: 邊界與資源適配
stages.description: 建立組織網路、盤點欄位與比較基準。
stages.descriptionEn: Establish the organizational network, inventory fields and baseline.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 劃定跨企業資源交換網路
steps.titleEn: Define an inter-company resource network
steps.objective: 將供應者、使用者與資源責任畫在同一系統圖。
steps.objectiveEn: Put suppliers, users and resource responsibilities on one system diagram.
steps.instruction: 畫來源廠 A、接收廠 B 與第三方設施 C；分別標水、能源、物料箭頭及跨企業負責者。
steps.instructionEn: Draw source plant A, receiving plant B and third-party facility C; label water, energy and material arrows and inter-company owners.
steps.observation: 資源可以跨企業循環，但品質與交付責任仍需明確。
steps.observationEn: Resources can circulate across firms while quality and delivery responsibilities still need definition.
steps.failure: 只畫循環箭頭不標所有者，會隱藏跨企業介面。
steps.failureEn: Drawing loops without owners hides inter-company interfaces.
steps.check: 每條交換線均有來源、接收者、資源類型與責任欄。
steps.checkEn: Give each exchange a source, receiver, resource type and responsibility field.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 工業共生將一個參與者的剩餘資源連到另一個參與者的需求。
knowledge.textEn: Industrial symbiosis links one participant’s surplus resources to another participant’s needs.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: A、B、C 是原創教學角色，不代表官方網路的特定現行合約。
knowledge.textEn: A, B and C are original teaching roles, not specific current contracts in the official network.

quiz.question: 哪條連接最容易進行介面審查？
quiz.questionEn: Which connection is easiest to review?
options: 同時標示資源、兩端組織與責任
只有箭頭，沒有資源類別
把所有公司合併成無責任單一節點
optionsEn: One naming the resource, both organizations and responsibility
An arrow without a resource type
All companies merged into an ownerless node
quiz.explanation: 工業共生將一個參與者的剩餘資源連到另一個參與者的需求。 A、B、C 是原創教學角色，不代表官方網路的特定現行合約。
quiz.explanationEn: Industrial symbiosis links one participant’s surplus resources to another participant’s needs. A, B and C are original teaching roles, not specific current contracts in the official network.

steps.title: 建立資源盤點欄位
steps.titleEn: Build a resource inventory
steps.objective: 讓數量、時間與品質資訊可以比較。
steps.objectiveEn: Make quantity, timing and quality information comparable.
steps.instruction: 設計三張資源卡，欄位包括名稱、數量單位、時段、品質限制與資料來源。
steps.instructionEn: Design three resource cards with name, quantity unit, time window, quality constraints and data source.
steps.observation: 同名資源可能因濃度、溫度或供應時段不同而不可互換。
steps.observationEn: Resources with the same name may not be interchangeable because of composition, temperature or timing.
steps.failure: 只記年總量會漏掉季節性與品質差異。
steps.failureEn: Recording annual totals alone misses seasonality and quality differences.
steps.check: 每張卡均能回答多少、何時、何種品質與由誰提供證據。
steps.checkEn: Each card must answer how much, when, at what quality and who provides evidence.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 交換可行性需要數量、品質、時間與位置同時匹配。
knowledge.textEn: Exchange feasibility requires matching quantity, quality, timing and location.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 未知資料應標待查證，不以零或最高品質代填。
knowledge.textEn: Unknown information should be marked unverified, not replaced with zero or the highest quality.

quiz.question: 只有資源名稱與年總量時，還缺什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is missing when only a resource name and annual total are known?
options: 更多裝飾圖示
時間分布、品質與介面資料
相同數值再重複一次
optionsEn: More decorative icons
Timing, quality and interface information
The same value repeated once more
quiz.explanation: 交換可行性需要數量、品質、時間與位置同時匹配。 未知資料應標待查證，不以零或最高品質代填。
quiz.explanationEn: Exchange feasibility requires matching quantity, quality, timing and location. Unknown information should be marked unverified, not replaced with zero or the highest quality.

steps.title: 保存交換前的比較基準
steps.titleEn: Preserve the pre-exchange baseline
steps.objective: 定義節省量所比較的原始情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Define the original scenario against which savings are compared.
steps.instruction: 分開列出無交換與有交換兩種情境的外購資源、處理需求與共同產出邊界。
steps.instructionEn: List purchased resources, treatment needs and common output boundaries for scenarios without and with exchange.
steps.observation: 只有產出與時間窗一致，節省量才有明確意義。
steps.observationEn: Savings are meaningful only when outputs and time windows are consistent.
steps.failure: 把低產量年度與高產量年度直接比較，會把減產誤當效率改善。
steps.failureEn: Comparing low- and high-output years directly can mistake reduced production for efficiency gains.
steps.check: 確認兩情境交付同等功能，並記錄所有假設差異。
steps.checkEn: Confirm equivalent delivered function and record all differing assumptions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 基準情境決定效益計算的比較對象。
knowledge.textEn: The baseline defines the comparison used to calculate benefits.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本課不重算官方減碳宣稱，只建立可審查比較方法。
knowledge.textEn: This course builds a reviewable comparison method rather than recalculating official carbon claims.

quiz.question: 哪兩個情境最適合比較交換效益？
quiz.questionEn: Which scenarios best support comparison of exchange benefits?
options: 產量和季節都不同且不作校正
只比較公司名稱長短
相同功能與時間窗，僅交換安排不同
optionsEn: Different outputs and seasons without adjustment
Compare company-name lengths only
Same function and time window, with exchange arrangements differing
quiz.explanation: 基準情境決定效益計算的比較對象。 本課不重算官方減碳宣稱，只建立可審查比較方法。
quiz.explanationEn: The baseline defines the comparison used to calculate benefits. This course builds a reviewable comparison method rather than recalculating official carbon claims.

steps.title: 篩選來源與需求的匹配
steps.titleEn: Screen source–demand matches
steps.objective: 識別數量吻合但品質不合的假匹配。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify false matches where quantity fits but quality does not.
steps.instruction: 設計來源卡「可供 10、品質未驗證」與需求卡「需要 8、品質需確認」，以紅黃綠分類但不批准連接。
steps.instructionEn: Create source card “10 available, quality unverified” and demand card “8 needed, quality confirmation required”; classify readiness without approving a connection.
steps.observation: 數量看似足夠，品質未知仍是未完成的匹配。
steps.observationEn: Quantity may appear sufficient while unknown quality leaves the match incomplete.
steps.failure: 只因 10 大於 8 就判定可直接使用，會漏掉適用性。
steps.failureEn: Approving use because 10 exceeds 8 overlooks fitness for purpose.
steps.check: 為數量、品質、時間、地點各列一個獨立狀態。
steps.checkEn: Give quantity, quality, timing and location separate status fields.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 工業交換需要滿足接收用途的條件，不能只看供應量。
knowledge.textEn: Industrial exchange must satisfy receiving-use conditions, not only supply volume.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 分類是概念篩選，實際連接需專業評估、協議與適用許可。
knowledge.textEn: Classification is conceptual screening; real connections need professional assessment, agreements and applicable permissions.

quiz.question: 上述來源與需求應如何標示？
quiz.questionEn: How should the source and demand be marked?
options: 數量初步足夠，品質仍待確認
所有條件自動通過
接收端需求完全不重要
optionsEn: Quantity provisionally sufficient; quality still unverified
All conditions automatically passed
Receiving requirements do not matter
quiz.explanation: 工業交換需要滿足接收用途的條件，不能只看供應量。 分類是概念篩選，實際連接需專業評估、協議與適用許可。
quiz.explanationEn: Industrial exchange must satisfy receiving-use conditions, not only supply volume. Classification is conceptual screening; real connections need professional assessment, agreements and applicable permissions.

stages.title: 守恆與交換介面
stages.description: 審查物料、熱、水與計量邊界。
stages.descriptionEn: Review material, heat, water and metering boundaries.
stages.route: 依學習相依關係閱讀；這四步是公開原理的概念任務，不是現場施工、操作或量產程序。
stages.routeEn: Follow the learning dependencies. These four tasks explore public principles; they are not field, operating or production procedures.

steps.title: 閉合單一物料交換帳
steps.titleEn: Close a single-material exchange account
steps.objective: 把接收量、剩餘量與損失分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate received quantity, remainder and losses.
steps.instruction: 用同一時段的假設帳：來源 10、接收 7、已知其他去向 1，求尚待交代的餘量。
steps.instructionEn: Use an assumed same-period account: source 10, received 7 and known other destination 1; calculate the unaccounted remainder.
steps.observation: 餘量為 2；不能因畫了交換箭頭就假設全部被利用。
steps.observationEn: The remainder is 2; an exchange arrow does not imply complete utilization.
steps.failure: 把來源 10 與接收 7 都算為節省 17，會重複計數。
steps.failureEn: Counting source 10 and receipt 7 as savings of 17 double-counts the transfer.
steps.check: 來源等於接收加其他去向加餘量，並檢查單位一致。
steps.checkEn: Verify source equals received plus other destinations plus remainder, using consistent units.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 物料在網路中的內部移轉不會創造額外物質。
knowledge.textEn: Internal transfers within a network do not create additional material.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本帳為自設例題，未交代餘量不是官方網路的實際排放或損失。
knowledge.textEn: This invented exercise does not identify real emissions or losses in the official network.

quiz.question: 例題尚待交代的餘量是多少？
quiz.questionEn: What remainder is still unaccounted for?
options: 0，因為資源已經循環
optionsEn: 0, because the resource circulates
quiz.explanation: 物料在網路中的內部移轉不會創造額外物質。 本帳為自設例題，未交代餘量不是官方網路的實際排放或損失。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal transfers within a network do not create additional material. This invented exercise does not identify real emissions or losses in the official network.

steps.title: 區分熱量與溫度適用性
steps.titleEn: Distinguish heat quantity from temperature suitability
steps.objective: 理解餘熱總量不能單獨決定用途。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why total surplus heat alone cannot determine its use.
steps.instruction: 畫來源熱流與兩個需求端，一個需求溫度較低、一個較高；用概念箭頭標出需進一步評估的提升介面。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a heat source and two demands at lower and higher temperature requirements; mark any upgrading interface needing evaluation.
steps.observation: 熱量相同的來源，因溫度不同而可能適合不同需求。
steps.observationEn: Sources with equal heat quantities can suit different demands because their temperatures differ.
steps.failure: 只看能量總數相等就宣告可直接替代，會忽略熱品位。
steps.failureEn: Declaring direct substitution from equal energy totals ignores heat quality.
steps.check: 同時列熱量單位與溫度條件，未知者保留空缺說明。
steps.checkEn: Record both heat quantity units and temperature conditions, explaining unknowns.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 熱的可利用性取決於溫差、需求與轉換介面。
knowledge.textEn: Heat usefulness depends on temperature difference, demand and conversion interfaces.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 本課不提供蒸汽管線、熱泵或受壓設備的設計操作參數。
knowledge.textEn: The lesson provides no design or operating settings for steam lines, heat pumps or pressure equipment.

quiz.question: 評估餘熱交換時，除了熱量還需什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is needed besides heat quantity when assessing heat exchange?
options: 只需來源廠商標誌
把熱量全部改成沒有單位的分數
來源與需求的溫度及介面條件
optionsEn: Only the source company’s logo
Convert all heat quantities to unitless scores
Source and demand temperatures and interface conditions
quiz.explanation: 熱的可利用性取決於溫差、需求與轉換介面。 本課不提供蒸汽管線、熱泵或受壓設備的設計操作參數。
quiz.explanationEn: Heat usefulness depends on temperature difference, demand and conversion interfaces. The lesson provides no design or operating settings for steam lines, heat pumps or pressure equipment.

steps.title: 確認水的用途適配
steps.titleEn: Check water fitness for purpose
steps.objective: 避免把回用水標籤當作所有用途都合格。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid treating a reused-water label as approval for every use.
steps.instruction: 以三張虛構需求卡列冷卻、清洗與更高品質製程用水；分別列待驗證的品質項。
steps.instructionEn: Create fictional cooling, washing and higher-quality process-water demand cards, listing quality evidence needed for each.
steps.observation: 同一水源可以適合一種用途而不適合另一種用途。
steps.observationEn: One water source can fit one use while failing another.
steps.failure: 把所有水需求合成單一容量欄會掩蓋交叉污染風險與品質限制。
steps.failureEn: Merging all water demands into one capacity field hides contamination concerns and quality constraints.
steps.check: 每個用途有獨立品質欄、來源與未驗證標記，不設定飲用安全結論。
steps.checkEn: Give every use a separate quality field, source and verification status without declaring drinking-water safety.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 資源循環需要符合接收用途，回用本身不保證品質。
knowledge.textEn: Circular use must meet receiving requirements; reuse alone does not guarantee quality.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 這是用途分類練習，不是水處理配方或供水驗收規範。
knowledge.textEn: This is a use-classification exercise, not a treatment recipe or water-supply acceptance specification.

quiz.question: 「可回用」標籤能否證明所有用途都適合？
quiz.questionEn: Does a “reusable” label establish suitability for every use?
options: 不能，需逐用途核對品質條件
可以，只要數量足夠
可以，水的用途不影響要求
optionsEn: No; quality conditions must be checked for each use
Yes, if the quantity is sufficient
Yes; water use does not affect requirements
quiz.explanation: 資源循環需要符合接收用途，回用本身不保證品質。 這是用途分類練習，不是水處理配方或供水驗收規範。
quiz.explanationEn: Circular use must meet receiving requirements; reuse alone does not guarantee quality. This is a use-classification exercise, not a treatment recipe or water-supply acceptance specification.

steps.title: 界定計量與所有權交接點
steps.titleEn: Define metering and ownership-transfer points
steps.objective: 使雙方對交換數量採一致邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Give both parties a consistent boundary for exchanged quantities.
steps.instruction: 在 A 到 B 的概念線上畫兩個計量點與一個交接點，標時間窗與誰保管讀值。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two meter points and one handover point on an A-to-B concept line, marking time windows and record owners.
steps.observation: 兩端讀值差異可能涉及時間、庫存、損失或儀表偏差。
steps.observationEn: Differences between end readings can involve timing, storage, losses or meter bias.
steps.failure: 未對齊時間就直接歸咎某一方，會把記帳差異誤判為違約。
steps.failureEn: Blaming one party before aligning time windows can mistake accounting differences for non-compliance.
steps.check: 比較前先統一單位與時間，再列差值的替代解釋。
steps.checkEn: Align units and time before comparison, then list alternative explanations for differences.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 計量點與責任交接點可能不同，必須明確記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Metering and responsibility-transfer points can differ and must be documented.

knowledge.title: 驗證與適用界限
knowledge.text: 概念線不揭示真實管線位置，也不授權接管或調整儀表。
knowledge.textEn: The concept line reveals no real pipeline route and authorizes no connection or meter adjustment.

quiz.question: 兩端讀值不同時第一步應是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What comes first when endpoint readings differ?
options: 立刻宣告其中一方違約
核對時間窗、單位與計量邊界
任選一個數字刪掉另一個
optionsEn: Immediately declare one party in breach
Check time windows, units and metering boundaries
Keep either number and delete the other
quiz.explanation: 計量點與責任交接點可能不同，必須明確記錄。 概念線不揭示真實管線位置，也不授權接管或調整儀表。
